slots.name: affected inmates
slots.sentence: Carruthers was among seven U.S. inmates whose executions by lethal injection failed because of issues establishing an IV line in the modern death penalty era, although researchers say other instances may exist.

slots.name: execution status
slots.sentence: Lee ultimately granted Carruthers a yearlong reprieve from execution, meaning that he'll return to the chamber a second time to be put to death after that.

slots.name: people killed
slots.sentence: In May, state officials called off the lethal injection of Tony Carruthers, who was convicted of kidnapping and killing three people in 1994, after executioners tried and failed for over an hour to place an IV to administer pentobarbital.

slots.name: execution date
slots.sentence: This is the second time in 2026 Tennessee has been unable to carry out an execution: In May, state officials called off the execution of Tony Carruthers after executioners failed to place an IV to administer the lethal injection.
